_note: Seed source for The Fay PM app. Claude Code: import these in apps/api/prisma/seed.ts and map to PMTemplate rows. weekday: 0=Sun..6=Sat. dayOfMonth for MONTHLY. requiredReadings become Reading inputs on the task. Assets should be upserted from the distinct `asset` values below.

templates.title: Daily Fire & Life Safety Check
checklist: Verify fire alarm/control systems for active faults or abnormal conditions
Check DOAS panel / AC Smart (HVAC) systems for alarms, faults, or abnormal operation
Inspect pool room and mechanical areas
Inspect mechanical units and verify normal operation
Document and log all inspections and abnormalities

templates.title: Daily Building & Common Areas Walk
checklist: Inspect common areas for cleanliness, damage, or maintenance issues
Check doors for proper operation and damage
Look for leaks, water intrusion, vandalism, or other deficiencies

templates.title: Weekly 23rd Floor / Amenity Areas
checklist: Inspect gym and fitness equipment for damage, loose components, or operational issues
Inspect gym bathrooms for defects, cleanliness, and maintenance issues
Check bathroom fixtures and plumbing for leaks
Inspect water bottle filling station / sink
Inspect planters and water plants as required
Inspect bathrooms for cleanliness, damage, and defects

templates.title: Weekly Fire/Life Safety & Building Systems
checklist: Inspect HVAC systems and verify normal operation
Check for leaks and abnormal conditions
Log findings and create work orders for deficiencies

templates.title: Weekly Elevator / Building Equipment
checklist: Verify elevator-related equipment is clean and accessible
Inspect swing-stage equipment and associated areas
Check for visible damage, corrosion, or unsafe conditions

templates.title: Monthly Fire Extinguisher Inspection
checklist: Inspect seals, pins, hoses, and physical condition

templates.title: Monthly Fire/Smoke Damper (FSD) Check
checklist: Perform monthly FSD unit checks where applicable
Verify accessible dampers are in proper condition and clean
Document deficiencies or units requiring service

templates.title: Monthly Fire Pump Run Test
checklist: Perform scheduled fire pump run test
Verify pump operation and check for abnormal conditions

templates.title: Monthly Elevator Emergency Systems Test
checklist: Test elevator recall function as scheduled
Inspect elevator emergency phone and verify operation/communication

templates.title: Monthly AC Unit Inspection
checklist: Perform monthly AC unit hatch inspections
Check for abnormal noises or operating conditions
Inspect coils and determine cleaning requirements; clean as required

templates.title: Monthly Roof HVAC Equipment
checklist: Check for refrigerant / water / condensate leaks
Clean coils and surrounding areas as required
Inspect transom units and condensate systems; clean transom units

templates.title: Monthly Mechanical Penthouse — Hot Water / Tank Systems
checklist: Inspect piping and valves for leaks
Clean and organize mechanical room; maintain clear access

templates.title: Monthly TPO Roof Inspection
checklist: Inspect and clean TPO roof areas
Remove debris from around equipment and drains
Check for visible damage or deficiencies
Verify roof areas remain clean and accessible

templates.title: Monthly Stairwell Cleaning & Inspection
checklist: Inspect walls, floors, doors, lighting, and handrails
Paint / touch up handrails as needed
Check stairwell doors for proper operation

templates.title: Monthly Exterior Areas Inspection
checklist: Identify areas requiring painting or touch-up
Check for water intrusion or leaks

templates.title: Monthly Trash Rooms / Compactor
checklist: Inspect walls, doors, drains, and surrounding areas
Check for odors or sanitation issues

templates.title: Monthly Pool Area Inspection
checklist: Inspect pool area; read and log equipment
Check pool equipment and surrounding areas
Inspect pipes and pool filter tank for leaks
Look for leaks or water-related damage
Verify area is clean and safe

templates.title: Monthly Gym Inspection
checklist: Inspect all gym equipment and check machines for safe operation
Check for loose, damaged, or worn components
Check bathrooms and sinks / water bottle stations

templates.title: Monthly Security Camera Inspection
checklist: Verify cameras are online and operational
Identify cameras that are offline or malfunctioning

templates.title: Monthly Emergency Phone / Contact Info Check
checklist: Confirm emergency contact information is current

templates.title: Monthly Water Softener / Salt System
checklist: Check salt level and add salt as required

templates.title: Monthly Generator Run Test & Inspection
checklist: Perform generator run test; verify it starts and operates properly
Verify automatic transfer operation where applicable
Record run time and readings; log all results

templates.title: Monthly Roof Inspection
checklist: Check HVAC equipment and for leaks
Inspect drains and drainage areas; remove debris
Inspect TPO roofing; clean rooftop areas
Inspect transom units and condensate systems
Document damage or areas requiring repair

templates.title: Monthly Elevator Control Room Inspection
checklist: Inspect elevator control room; verify clean and accessible
Verify doors and access are secure

templates.title: Monthly Firefighter Air Response Room (FAR)
checklist: Inspect FAR systems and call vendor to refill system
Verify room is clean and accessible

templates.title: Monthly Swing Stage Equipment Inspection
checklist: Inspect swing-stage equipment and associated areas
Check visible cables, equipment, connections, and mounting areas
Look for corrosion, damage, or unsafe conditions
Document deficiencies and report items requiring specialized inspection/service
